subject: HackWeek partner request — staggered trial codes & 2-week extensions
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma@codeforimpact.org>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: HackWeek partner promo: trial pool & staggered release?

Hi Irene + Marissa,

Hope you're both well — Code for Impact is running our annual HackWeek (Feb 15-21) and we had a quick ask: would Redwood provide a small pool of trial credits for attendees (students, nonprofit devs, and mentors)? We expect ~600 signups across workshops.

Two specific asks:
- A two-week trial extension beyond the standard trial window so attendees can complete follow-up projects.
- Staggered delivery of promo codes over the week (so cohorts get codes on Day 1/Day 3/Day 5) to reduce burst risk and preserve per-attendee experience.

We'd also love to co-promote Redwood on our event page and social channels if you can support the credits.

Happy to share attendee counts, logos, and a one‑pager. Is this something you can enable? If so, any requirements on our side (T&Cs, attendee email format, partner agreement)?

Best,
Emma
Emma Carter

+1 415-555-0198

Subject: Re: HackWeek partner promo: trial pool & staggered release?

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and congrats on getting HackWeek lined up. We can support this, conditional on a couple of operational details. Quick answers up front: yes to a 2-week extension for trial accounts created via partner codes, and yes to staggered code delivery.

A few items we need to finalize:
- Exact attendee count and whether attendees are separate emails (we prefer single-use codes tied to attendee emails).
- Confirmation that attendee emails are personal or organizational (we have to restrict shared mailbox flows).
- Logo + short blurb for our partner page (PNG/SVG preferred).
- Any billing/badge requirements for co-marketing (e.g., must include Redwood logo in sponsor section).

Operational proposal from our side (draft):
- Allocation: 600 total promo credits (500 core + 100 reserve).
- Release pattern: 100 codes on Day 0, then 125/day over next 4 days (can adjust to your cohort schedule).
- Trial period: 14 days from first code redemption.
- Redemption window: codes valid Feb 15–Mar 1.

Marissa — tagging you for credit approval and any limits we should observe. Karthik — can you own the final delivery email and code redemption page?

If that sounds workable, can you send the attendee list (email only is fine) and logo assets? I can turn this into an allocation sheet and get it approved today.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
